notes: Premium+ PDU with RackLink (Raritan Xerus platform), 9-outlet 20A unit with 2-Stage MOV surge protection (the RLNK-P920R-SP sibling instead uses "Series Protection" surge and adds per-outlet metering). Outlets: 9x NEMA 5-20R total = 8 rear IP-controllable outlets + 1 front-panel convenience outlet (uncontrolled), all on one shared NEMA 5-20P/20A input circuit. Power input is a permanently-attached 9 ft cord terminating in a NEMA 5-20P plug (not a detachable IEC inlet), modeled here as a nema-5-15 port (closest list option; actual plug is 5-20P, 20A/120V). One RJ-45 Ethernet port for RackLink management/monitoring (LAN/SNMP/RESTful API/SSH/HTTPS) — link speed is not published by Middle Atlantic/Legrand for this SKU, so grade is omitted (commonly 10/100 on this PDU family). The unit also supports up to 32 daisy-chained environmental (temp/humidity) sensors via a proprietary RJ-45-style "feature/sensor" port, but the exact connector and count could not be confirmed from available sources, so it is not listed as a port. No USB port is documented on this model. Rack size 1RU, 19"W x 9.83"D x 1.75"H, horizontal mount, ~13 lbs. Primary data pulled from the Legrand/Middle Atlantic hosted spec-sheet PDF (rlnkp920rsp-spec.pdf, covering the closely related -SP variant's electrical specs which match the base unit) plus corroborating retailer spec tables (B&H, standsandmounts.com, compsource) for outlet/cord/dimension details, since the live legrandav.com and Middle Atlantic product pages did not render their spec tables via fetch.
